verdict.rationale: Loops runs an official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.loops.so, one-line `claude mcp add` install) that lets Claude or any remote MCP client manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional email, work with events, and reach the rest of the API. Installable agent skills let coding agents set up, migrate, and author content and workflows on a user's behalf, so natural-language operation through an agent is clearly supported. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (all of this requires bringing your own agent client), any independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation, and documented natural-language coverage of campaign sending and workflow editing through MCP specifically.
